name: carepath
description: CarePath Sonipat — ambulance SOS, AI care guide, hospital finder and insurance help.

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend --legacy-peer-deps && npm install --prefix frontend --legacy-peer-deps && node -e "require('fs').existsSync('backend/.env')||require('fs').copyFileSync('backend/.env.example','backend/.env')" && npm run seed --prefix backend -- --demo
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
